_what: ServerNetworkHandler::_processValidatedLoginPacket - the PlayerAuthenticationInfo copy-constructor call at 0xb89550 (helper 0xb881d0). It builds the PlayerAuthenticationInfo BDS then hands to player creation, at the destination held in r14 (lea r14,[rbp+0x340] right before the call; r14 is callee-saved, so it still points at the copy when the call returns). The copy is a plain PlayerAuthenticationInfo with no engaged flag, so offset_engaged is unused.
_register_contract: At the call: rcx = &copy (destination, = r14), rdx = rdi = const PlayerAuthenticationInfo& (the source, the function's 4th parameter homed from r9), r14 = &copy held across. result_register r14 = the copy the hook reads and rewrites.
_abi: MSVC x86-64. std::string is 32 bytes (data+0, size+16, capacity+24; small-string buffer holds 15 chars). BDS dynamically links msvcp140.dll/vcruntime140.dll/UCRT, so the shim (built /MD) shares the same std::string ABI and heap: the XUID is written with the real std::string::assign, which allocates when it does not fit the 15-char buffer.
_derived_by: Located by the unique code reference to the function's own signature string in bedrock_server.exe 1.26.65.1; field offsets from the copy constructor's per-member std::string layout (xuid is string member 0, xbox_live_name is string member 6 = 0xC0), cross-checked against the 1.26.65.1 Linux profile (xuid 0, xbox_live_name 144 = 6*24). Signature is unique (1 match) over the executable sections; the call's rel32 derives helper 0xb881d0.
